## Free public transport

Key `transit_free`. Fares are scrapped. Adds +30% transit coverage everywhere and +2% mood, but the operators must still be paid.

- Upkeep: 2 per second
- Modifiers: `cov_transit` 0.3, `mood` 0.02

## Recycling programme

Key `recycling`. Kerbside recycling. Adds +35% waste coverage everywhere and +1% mood.

- Upkeep: 1 per second
- Modifiers: `cov_waste` 0.35, `mood` 0.01

## Neighbourhood watch

Key `watch`. Volunteers patrol the streets. Theft losses fall by 40%. Cheap, but no substitute for police.

- Upkeep: 0.8 per second
- Modifiers: `crime_mult` 0.6

## Business subsidies

Key `biz_subsidy`. Tax breaks for shops and factories. +12% commercial and industrial income.

- Upkeep: 1.5 per second
- Modifiers: `sales_mult` 1.12, `goods_mult` 1.12

## Tourism campaign

Key `tourism`. Posters in every airport. Doubles tourism income from stadiums, museums, hotels and theme parks.

- Upkeep: 1.5 per second
- Modifiers: `tour_mult` 2

## Free schooling

Key `free_school`. Books and meals for every child. Adds +20% education coverage and +1% mood.

- Upkeep: 1.5 per second
- Modifiers: `cov_edu` 0.2, `mood` 0.01

## Clean air rules

Key `clean_air`. Filters on every chimney. Halves pollution but factories earn 10% less.

- Upkeep: 0.5 per second
- Modifiers: `poll_mult` 0.5, `goods_mult` 0.9

## Austerity budget

Key `austerity`. Everything gets trimmed. Upkeep falls 15% and you save coins every second, but mood drops 5%.

- Upkeep: -1 per second
- Modifiers: `upkeep_mult` 0.85, `mood` -0.05

## Night curfew

Key `curfew`. Streets empty after dark. Theft losses halve, but mood drops 4%.

- Upkeep: 0.5 per second
- Modifiers: `crime_mult` 0.5, `mood` -0.04

## Stop and search

Key `stop_search`. Officers may search anyone. Crime falls 30% but mood drops 3%. Cheap, divisive.

- Upkeep: 0.4 per second
- Modifiers: `crime_mult` 0.7, `mood` -0.03

## Community policing

Key `community_police`. Officers walk the beat and know the locals. +15% police coverage, crime -10%, mood +1%.

- Upkeep: 1.2 per second
- Modifiers: `cov_police` 0.15, `mood` 0.01, `crime_mult` 0.9

## Garrison

Key `garrison`. Soldiers man the borders. +30% defence coverage: raids do less damage and your side wins more battles. Costs upkeep, mood -1%.

- Upkeep: 1.5 per second
- Modifiers: `cov_defence` 0.3, `mood` -0.01

## Disaster insurance

Key `insurance`. Premiums every second. When fire, storms, quakes or tornadoes destroy a building, the insurer pays the city $30 for it.

- Upkeep: 1 per second
- Modifiers: `insured` 1

## Cost-of-living payments

Key `cost_support`. The council tops up households that have run out of savings: they receive a small payment every second so rent and food stay covered. Eases unrest during price surges and slumps, but it costs upkeep and does not create jobs.

- Upkeep: 2 per second
- Modifiers: `stipend` 0.12

## Fast-track permits

Key `fast_track`. Planning approvals in days. New buildings finish 60% faster.

- Upkeep: 1 per second
- Modifiers: `build_mult` 1.6
